title: Multiparameter $C$-semigroups and multiparameter $C$-cosine functions
summary: In this paper, we present several new results concerning multiparameter $C$-semigroups. We introduce and systematically analyze the class of multiparameter $C$-cosine functions, providing several new structural results and applications to abstract multiparameter Cauchy problems of first/second order in locally convex spaces. We also consider automatic extensions of multiparameter $C$-semigroups and multiparameter $C$-cosine functions.
